data.name: Riddhi
data.gender_notes: Riddhi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The goddess of wealth, fortune and prosperity. She is the one who grants all material and spiritual desires to her devotees. She is considered the goddess of all wealth and treasures, and is worshipped to gain material wealth as well as inner happiness. The name Riddhi carries the meaning “Wealth, Prosperity, Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Riddhi usually hope their child will grow to embody wealth, prosperity, fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner wealth, abundance, and prosperity. It is believed that the name Riddhi brings wealth, prosperity, and success in all areas of life.
data.etymology: Riddhi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealth, Prosperity, Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Riddhi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Riddhi" holds significant cultural importance in Hinduism. It calls to mind images of prosperity, abundance and good fortune. The goddess Riddhi is believed to be a goddess of wealth and riches. She is often depicted as a beautiful, golden-skinned goddess with four arms, holding symbols of wealth, such as a branch of the pippal tree (as the Vedic sacrifice tree) and a lotus. Hername is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is themain goddess of wealth and prosperity in Hinduism. In many Hindu households, their images are often displayed together or separately, with Riddhi symbolizing the accumulation of material wealth and Lakshmi representing the inner spiritual abundance and happiness.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Riddhi" is not just a symbol of material wealth but is also associated with inner spiritual abundance and happiness. In Hinduism, it is believed that the path to achieving true spiritual growth and enlightenment is through material prosperity and worldly success. Riddhi represents the goddess who grants these desires. However, she is not just a chaotic goddess of wealth but also a compassionate and nurturing one. She bestows her blessings not only on those who seek material wealth but also on those who strive for inner peace and self-realization. It is believed that by worshipping Riddhi, one can not only gain worldly success and happiness but also experience true inner joy and contentment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Riddhi symbolizes prosperity, wealth, and abundance in life. It is believed that the goddess Riddhi bestows fortune and success upon her devotees. Her name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ridh' meaning 'wealth' or 'prosperity'.

vedic_reference.note: Riddhi is a name of Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity in Hinduism. She is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures and is an important deity in Hindu mythology.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Riddhi is a goddess in Hinduism, often depicted as the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Riddhi carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Riddhi is a goddess in Hinduism and is often depicted as the goddess of wealth and prosperity. She is the consort of the god Vishnu and is believed to bring good fortune and abundance to those who worship her.
